data.long_meaning: The name Aj is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अज’ (aj) which means ‘not born’, ‘immortal’, or ‘breath’ in Hindu mythology. This name is associated with the concept of the eternal soul and the breath of life. The name Aj carries the meaning “Breath, Life” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aj usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, life and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Aj is a reminder of this spiritual truth, and it inspires one to live in the present moment, while keeping in mind the ultimate goal of spiritual liberation (Moksha).
